{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Dessert|Dessert]] | [[Cookbook:Cake|Cake]]

Nothing more delicious in the way of cake can be made than '''sunshine cake'''. It is especially nice to serve with a frozen dessert of some kind, for it is not too rich and it is attractive in color.

==Ingredients==
*6 [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]], [[Cookbook:Separating Eggs|separated]]
*⅓ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Cream of Tartar|cream of tartar]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] white granulated [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
*¾ cup [[Cookbook:Flour|flour]]
*1 tsp [[Cookbook:Lemon|lemon juice]]
*1 tsp [[Cookbook:Vanilla|vanilla]]

==Procedure==

# [[Cookbook:Whipping|Whip]] the yolks with a rotary beater until they are thick and lemon-colored.
# Whip the egg whites until they are foamy, add the cream of tartar, and continue whipping until they are dry.
# [[Cookbook:Folding|Fold]] the sugar into the egg whites, then then fold the yolks into this mixture.
# [[Cookbook:Sifting|Sift]] the flour several times and add it.
# Add the lemon juice and vanilla.
# Pour batter into a sponge-[[Cookbook:Cake Pan|cake pan]], and bake.

==Notes, tips, and variations==

* Original source is{{Gutenberg|name=Woman's Institute Library of Cookery, Vol. 4|no=9938}}
